media.title: Media
media.description: Images, PDFs, video and audio this brain has read. Text in any language, PDF pages, video keyframes and speech become memories you can recall.
media.liveDescription: Point the camera at text: it is read live in any language. Remember a frame to keep it as a memory.
media.uploadHint: Images, PDF, video (MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV) or audio (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, FLAC).
media.emptyBody: Drop a file above, or open the live camera. Its text is read and indexed into this brain.
media.noReader: The media reader is not configured on the server (OCR_URL), so uploads stay pending until it is.
media.confirmDeleteBody: The file, its note and the memories made from it are removed.
media.reading: Reading the file… text appears here when it is done.
media.noText: No text or speech was found in this file.
media.cameraDenied: Camera access was denied or no camera is available
media.liveIdle: Start the camera to read text live
media.phone.title: Scan with your phone
media.phone.description: Scan this code with your phone camera. It opens straight into this brain's live camera, with no sign-in on the phone.
media.phone.connectedBody: Frames you save on the phone appear here. The phone can use the camera until {time}.
media.phone.expiredBody: Make a new code to connect a phone.
media.phone.codeUsed: This QR code was already used or has expired.
media.phone.scanAgain: Show a new QR code on your computer (Media → Use your phone) and scan it again.
